A tidy-up release.

### What's changed
- **No simulator.** The program always works with your card printer. Simulator mode was only ever for development and has been removed from the program; if it was switched on, the program now uses the printer chosen in Settings.
- The page on GitHub now shows the program properly, with screenshots, features, install steps and answers to common questions.

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients and people.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.3 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.3.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
